name: Singularity
design_intent: OWNER 2026-07-18: 'party levels where we start off orbiting a black hole'. One central gravity well (constant radial pull g=1000 inside r=1500) whose core is a round BUMPER ball (body_r 120) dressed as the event horizon: a lethal core was tried first (r=130, then 70) and LIVE-MEASURED as a bot blender - 32/36 deaths were uncredited core suicides (bot recovery logic is screen-down biased and orbit-decays into the middle), so a kill-race match could never end. As a bumper the hole is a violent pinball hub - dives slingshot or ricochet (stunned victims dry-reflect, no refund) - and kills happen the classic credited way: smash rivals OUT past the blast bounds (edge deaths were already occurring in the probe). Four trampoline shell-platforms at compass points are the local floors; four corner bumpers + two bumper pylons deflect careless orbits. kill_shape dual_blast-ish: every bound is live. Space palette + stars; the source draws its own field-extent ring (telegraphy).
